turns.t: Dr Whitaker, here's Mr Lindqvist. Obs done: blood pressure 152 over 94, pulse 72. He's here about his results.
Thank you, nurse. Mr Lindqvist, come in. Tell me what you understand about why you're here. ~
Er, the letter said something about protein in my water, and that my pressure was up. That's about all I've got, I'm afraid.
That's fine, that's what I wanted to explain. Have you noticed anything yourself in the toilet?
It's, er, a bit frothy. Foamy. I noticed it a while back, I don't know, a few months? Maybe more. I can't pin it down.
Foamy urine, a few months or more. Thank you. ~
Is that important? ~
It can be, because foam sometimes means protein is leaking through the kidneys. ~
Leaking? ~
Think of the kidneys as a very fine sieve. Normally it keeps protein in the blood. When the sieve is under strain, some gets through. ~
And the blood pressure causes that? ~
High blood pressure can strain the sieve, and kidney trouble can also push the blood pressure up. They feed each other. ~
A vicious circle. ~
Exactly. Any operations in the past that I should know about?
My appendix, in 1999. That's all.
Right. Nurse, can you pop him on the couch? ~
Of course.
Your ankles, Mr Lindqvist, let me press. There's no swelling in either ankle.
Good. ~
Let me explain what I'd like to do. The first thing is to repeat the urine test, with a proper measurement of the protein.
Okay. ~
I'd also like to arrange blood tests to check how well your kidneys are working.
Is it serious? ~
It's too early to say. That's why we need the tests. ~
I understand. How long will it take? ~
A week or so for the results. The nurse will give you a pot for the urine sample. ~
I've got it here, Mr Lindqvist. First thing in the morning, please. ~
First thing in the morning, got it. ~
Keep your salt low, and don't take anti-inflammatory painkillers like ibuprofen for now.
Right, I'll remember. ~
If the protein is still there on the repeat, I'd like to see you again and talk about a referral to a kidney specialist.
Understood. Thank you, doctor. ~
